newsitem.title: INDIA: Magneti in Indian auto parts venture.
newsitem.headline: Magneti in Indian auto parts venture.

text.p: Indian carmaker Premier Automobiles Ltd (PAL) said on Wednesday it was setting up a joint venture company with Italian auto components maker Magneti Marelli S.p.A.
The new auto components company -- Magneti Marelli (India) Ltd -- will be 76 percent-owned by the Italian firm and 24 percent by PAL.
Maitreya Doshi, PAL managing director, said the initial project cost would be around 250 million rupees.
The joint venture will set up a production unit in Pune in Maharashtra state in western India. It is expected to start production by the end of 1997.
Doshi said the initial capital of the company would be 125 million rupees.
